tasks.scenario: You are following a short TensorFlow tutorial with a tiny in-memory example. Choose the environment that supplies TensorFlow without reserving more compute than this introductory exercise needs.

A colleague asks you to run a small Keras learning example using only toy data. Select an environment with the required framework while following the policy to use the smallest adequate resource profile.
You need a notebook for a short Python exercise that reads a few small JSON files and computes basic summaries using the standard library. No scientific or machine-learning packages are required.
Prepare an environment for a lightweight Python script that checks several configuration records and prints counts. The data fits in memory and the work needs only ordinary Python and JupyterLab.
Explore and clean an approximately 0.8 GB CSV file with pandas, then create several plots with Matplotlib. The table should fit in a moderate notebook environment and no GPU is needed.

Investigate a collection of tabular survey exports totalling about 800 MB. You plan to merge them with pandas and visualize distributions using common Python data-science packages, without GPU computation.

Train a PyTorch neural network on CPU with a workload expected to use roughly 1.3 GB of memory. The cluster has no GPU device, but the notebook must include PyTorch and needs the largest available memory envelope to run safely.

Run a CPU-only deep-learning experiment using PyTorch. Model and data preparation are expected to approach 1.3 GB of memory, so choose the available profile with sufficient headroom and an image containing the required framework; no physical GPU is available.
